plugins.Author: erdelf, Herculezz
plugins.Name: AutoDuty
plugins.Punchline: Dungeons while you sleep, eat, or work. (Swimsuit Shtola made easy.)
plugins.Description: A plugin to run dungeons for you with Trust, Duty Support, Squadrons, Variants, and Regular, Requires BossMod, vnavmesh and a Rotation Plugin (BossMod AutoRotation, Wrath or RotationSolverReborn)
plugins.Changelog:
## What's Changed
* (1048) Porta Decumana: Stabilizing by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/395
* AutoRetainer MultiMode Between Loops by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/397
* Gimmick Novice Entries only when lvl 49 or above by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/398
* Create Default profile if no profile exists by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/399
* Playlist saving by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/400
* Shisui in the stable leveling list by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/401
* (1036) Sastasha: Safety check for keys by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/402
* Collision Condition by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/404
* Optionally disabling party coherency by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/406
* ToDo Condition by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/408
* Revival logic adjusted by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/410
* Glamour Chests only when unlocked by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/412
* (1036) Sastasha: Safety check for interactions by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/409
* (1127) React to Attack Markers: Update Party Coherency flag by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/407
* (1142) Sirensong: Revamp boat opening by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/405

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/compare/0.0.0.330...0.0.0.335
